articles.title: Mauricio Pochettino to Leave US Men's National Team After Manchester United Move
articles.summary: US men's national team head coach Mauricio Pochettino has announced his decision to join Manchester United and will leave his position after the Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal against Haiti.
articles.content: Mauricio Pochettino has made it clear he won't be getting emotional about his time as head coach of the US men's national team coming to an end. The outgoing coach is focused on keeping things business as usual despite the impending conclusion of his tenure with Tuesday's Concacaf Nations League quarterfinal against Haiti marking a significant milestone. Pochettino has navigated two years of speculation about his future, with various European clubs expressing interest in hiring him, until last week when he announced his decision to join Manchester United. His move to Manchester United has finally brought clarity to the situation and allowed the team to focus on the task at hand. The USMNT's recent struggles have been well-documented under Mauricio Pochettino's tenure, but his focus has shifted to building a lasting legacy rather than dwelling on past mistakes. A telling aspect of his approach is the emphasis he places on molding the team's mentality, which often takes precedence over fine-tuning their playing style. This can be seen in the way he allocates time and resources during training sessions, prioritizing mental preparation alongside technical development. The upcoming match against Haiti offers a chance for Pochettino to leave his mark before departing for Manchester United, with the first leg advantage making it possible for the team to survive an underwhelming performance. However, the real significance of this game lies in its potential to lay the groundwork for future success. In doing so, Pochettino aims to create a seamless transition between his tenure and that of his successors, as evident from his comments on building connections with new coaches and players. "What I hope is to create the same link with us, with the new coaches that arrive here," he said. The upcoming game against will serve as a platform for the players who are likely to remain with the team after Pochettino's departure. His exit is imminent, but the impact he has had on the squad cannot be overstated. The young players like Julian Hall, who have already shown promise in their first few games, were probably destined for success regardless of the coach. The past week has seen several players praise the cultural shift and style of play implemented by Pochettino during his tenure. His influence is still evident, even as he prepares to leave. The team's ability to prioritize its style of play with the next hire presents a unique opportunity that may not have been available in the past. The financial might of soccer can certainly be a factor in attracting top coaches, but there is also a compelling argument for taking on this role based on pure soccer principles. For the first time in recent memory, the USMNT has the chance to focus on finding a coach who shares its vision and values. Pochettino's eventual successor will likely face immense pressure to perform well, especially considering the team's strong showing under his leadership. However, this also presents an opportunity for the new coach to put their own stamp on the team and shape its future direction. As Mauricio Pochettino's tenure with the USMNT comes to a close, rumors have emerged about his potential replacement. The appointment of Pep Guardiola has been mentioned, but it remains unclear whether he is genuinely interested in the position. The current setup seems tailored to the needs of the team that performed well at this year's World Cup, particularly for younger players like Cavan Sullivan, who has gained recognition as a nominee for MLS' Most Valuable Player award despite being just 17 years old and part of the Philadelphia Union. A successful performance on Tuesday could help justify Pochettino's time in charge, demonstrating that his approach can serve as a stepping stone to future success. This would ideally allow experienced players to thrive alongside their younger teammates, regardless of who takes over the team. Pochettino is simultaneously laying the groundwork for the USMNT's long-term prospects while preparing for his own new role. His assistant coach, Jesus Perez, and other key staff members have already left Cincinnati, with some departing earlier than others, including goalkeeper coach Toni Jimenez and sports scientist Sebastiano Pochettino. As Mauricio Pochettino prepares for his new role at Manchester United, he will be taking on a familiar challenge, starting a new job with limited time to spare. The timing of his arrival is crucial, given that United's first training session under him won't take place until Thursday. This brief transition period is not without precedent in Pochettino's career. He has navigated similar situations before, including when he took charge of Tottenham Hotspur and Chelsea. His experience will likely be invaluable as he steers the ship at Old Trafford. Pochettino's comments on the matter are reassuring, as he emphasizes his ability to adapt quickly. articles.title: Jury Decision-Making Process Analyzed Through Virtual Mock Juries
articles.summary: A new study is shedding light on how juries make decisions, particularly when faced with disagreement among its members.
articles.content: A new study is shedding light on how juries make decisions, particularly when faced with disagreement among its members. Researchers led by Tova Cohen, a Ph.D. student at Rutgers School of Criminal Justice, conducted an in-depth analysis of virtual mock juries to gain insight into the decision-making process. The study involved 35 participants who were divided into seven virtual mock juries, allowing researchers to examine individual characteristics and group dynamics. The researchers aimed to understand how jurors interact with each other during deliberations, especially when faced with conflicting opinions. This is crucial for collective legal decision-making in the U.S. criminal legal system. Cohen emphasizes that understanding jury deliberation is essential for grasping the complexities of the process. "Jury deliberation is a significant component of the U.S. criminal legal system and is important for collective legal decision-making," she said. By examining how jurors respond to disagreement, researchers can gain a deeper understanding of the factors influencing their decisions. The study's findings reveal that personal characteristics play a role in determining individual participation levels during deliberations. However, other traits such as agreeableness, openness, and civic engagement were not found to be predictive of increased involvement in discussions. Researchers also discovered that disagreement among jurors can serve as an opportunity for individuals to express competing interpretations of the evidence. After one deliberation, participants' initial verdict preferences shifted, with some who initially voted "not guilty" ultimately reporting a guilty verdict. The study's results suggest that understanding jury decisions requires more than just examining final verdicts. It also involves analyzing how jurors participate in discussions and work together to reach consensus. The researchers' findings contribute significantly to the ongoing discussion on collective decision-making processes within juries. The study's findings emphasize the significance of interpersonal dynamics within juries to understanding how jurors participate and reach a consensus. Researchers have long been interested in the collective decision-making processes of juries, but there has been limited research on the role of dissenting jurors in this process. The study highlights the crucial distinction between the outcome of deliberation and the processes by which jurors arrive at it. The researchers' findings contribute significantly to the ongoing discussion on collective decision-making processes within juries, providing valuable insights into the importance of interpersonal dynamics during jury deliberations. Ultimately, a deeper understanding of these dynamics can lead to more informed and just outcomes in the judicial system. articles.content: Robert Pattinson has officially taken on the iconic role of James Bond, marking the beginning of a new era for the legendary spy franchise. Over the past six decades, seven actors have brought the character to life on screen, each leaving their own unique mark on the franchise. Daniel Craig's tenure as Bond came to an end in 2021 with "No Time To Die, where his Bond met his demise. Before Pattinson takes up the mantle of 007, let's take a look at how previous Bonds have been received by audiences and critics alike. A new ranking has been compiled, evaluating all seven actors who have portrayed James Bond in film. Interestingly, there was an earlier adaptation of Casino Royale released in 1967, starring David Niven as Bond and taking a more comedic approach to the original novel by Ian Fleming. The lesser-known adaptation of Casino Royale released in 1967 took a more comedic approach to Ian Fleming's novel, starring David Niven as Bond. In contrast, another actor who played James Bond was George Lazenby, an Australian actor who appeared in the film On Her Majesty's Secret Service in 1969. He was drafted by Eon Productions after Sean Connery stepped away from the role. Lazenby's contribution to the franchise is often considered a matter of courtesy. Pierce Brosnan's tenure as Bond lasted from 1995 to 2002, and his legacy has been somewhat forgotten following Daniel Craig's more recent portrayal of the character. However, revisiting Brosnan's performance can provide valuable insights into the evolution of the James Bond franchise. The shift in tone of the James Bond franchise can be seen in Roger Moore's tenure as 007. His seven-film run, which spanned from 1973 to 1985, was marked by a reliance on big-budget stunts and chaotic action sequences. Moore's Bond films were often criticized for lacking substance, with plots struggling to hold together the elaborate set pieces. This approach was largely due to the influence of British director John Glen, who had a knack for capturing mayhem on screen. Glen's style, which emphasized spectacle over subtlety, was well-suited to Moore's Bond, but it also contributed to the franchise's decline in terms of narrative coherence. Despite this, Moore remains one of the most charismatic actors to have played Bond, bringing a sense of humor and charm to the role. Moore's on-screen persona was often at odds with the character's supposed sophistication and coolness, instead leaning into absurdity and camp. This approach may not have been to everyone's taste, but it has its defenders among fans of the franchise. Moore's seven-film tenure has been criticized for lacking rewatch value. In contrast, Timothy Dalton's portrayal of 007 in The Living Daylights" and "Licence to Kill stands out as a critically acclaimed take on the character. Dalton's dark and serious interpretation of Bond is seen by many as the most accurate representation of Fleming's literary creation. It's not about making him human," Dalton said, but rather showing that he's flawed. Sean Connery's legacy as a Hollywood icon extends far beyond his portrayal of James Bond. With a filmography that boasts over 50 movies, including classics like "Marnie," "Indiana Jones and the Last Crusade," and "The Untouchables, which earned him an Oscar for best supporting actor. Connery's association with the character of 007 predates his on-screen debut in 1962. He has revealed that he was not introduced to Ian Fleming, the author of the James Bond novels, until well into the production of the first film. Not surprisingly, this delayed introduction did little to endear Connery to Fleming. Connery's enduring connection with the character is a testament to his own charisma and screen presence. As Barbara Walters observed in an interview from 1987, Connery exuded class without trying to be overtly sexy. This understated charm helped to make him the coolest Bond on-screen. Connery remains the only actor to have convincingly delivered the now-iconic catchphrase Martini, shaken, not stirred. His delivery imbued the phrase with a level of sophistication that has since become synonymous with the character. Daniel Craig's portrayal of James Bond has left a lasting impact on the franchise, setting a new standard for future Bonds to follow. His films have consistently pushed the boundaries of what audiences expect from 007, delivering dark and physically demanding performances that have captivated viewers worldwide. Craig's commercial success is evident in the box office numbers, with his most recent film No Time To Die" grossing over $906 million worldwide, a testament to his enduring appeal as Bond. The film also marked the culmination of Craig's decade-long tenure as 007, a period during which he helped revitalize the franchise and cement its place in popular culture, ensuring that the iconic character will continue to thrive for years to come. The lack of a reliable defensive unit has put immense pressure on Prescott and his teammates to perform at an exceptionally high level every time they take the field. Prescott's comments after the game highlighted the team's awareness of their problems, but it remains to be seen whether they can address these issues before it's too late. The Cowboys' porous defense continues to plague the team as they prepare to face Tennessee on Sunday. Dallas's inability to contain Christian McCaffrey was a major concern last week, as he became the first running back in NFL history to record two touchdown catches of at least 65 yards in the same game. His 74-yard and 66-yard receptions were significant blows to the Cowboys' defense. The team struggled to keep up with McCaffrey's speed and agility. The defense also allowed Deebo Samuel to run 70 yards for a touchdown on a reverse play, which added to their woes. Furthermore, running back Kaelon Black managed to push aside defenders and score a 25-yard touchdown run. The Cowboys' inability to contain opponents' big plays is becoming a recurring theme. This season alone, the team has surrendered nine plays of at least 50 yards, more than double the number of any other NFL team. articles.title: Gérard Darel Jeans Popular among Parisians at Fashion Week
articles.summary: The Anna jeans from Gérard Darel were seen repeatedly on showgoers and locals during Paris Fashion Week last month, showcasing the brand's understated yet elegant style.
articles.content: Fashion Week in Paris last month was abuzz with style trends, but one particular trend caught my attention - the ubiquity of a specific type of jeans among showgoers and locals alike. The flashiest outfits on display were often courtesy of brands sponsoring the events, making it difficult to report on street style without feeling like I was promoting a product rather than observing authentic fashion choices. In contrast, Parisians seemed uninterested in following trends or dressing for effect. They preferred to stick with what worked for them, and one item that kept popping up was jeans - not just any jeans, but a particular high-waisted, flared style that I saw repeatedly during my time at the shows. As I watched a woman climb onto her Lime bike outside Le Saint-Gervais bar, I found myself drawn to her outfit. She caught my eye and paused for a moment before swinging her leg over the saddle, giving me just enough time to ask where she got her jeans from. "Anna," she said finally, "Gérard Darel." The brand has been synonymous with effortless French style for decades, its discreet designs effortlessly blending into everyday Parisian life. Gérard Darel's iconic 24H bag is a ubiquitous sight on the city's Métro, often stuffed with school supplies and tangled headphones during the morning rush. This understated approach to fashion is a hallmark of the brand's aesthetic, one that has been adopted by generations of French women who value simplicity and elegance in their wardrobes. As for the jeans themselves, they may have originated in America but have since become an integral part of the Gérard Darel wardrobe, with a timeless design that never goes out of style. The Anna jeans, designed by former creative director Valérie Gerbi, are a particular favorite among fashion enthusiasts and celebrities alike, including supermodel Kate Moss who has been spotted wearing them on numerous occasions. The Anna jeans' design features double belt loops that crisscross along the waistband to create a flattering illusion of a cinched silhouette. This clever detail is complemented by the back pockets, which add a touch of sophistication and balance out the overall look. The true magic of these jeans lies in how they can be styled to perfection, as seen in Kate Moss's effortless ensembles featuring white ballet flats that appear to be from Repetto's men's collection, paired with a navy three-quarter-zip jumper. The result is a chic, laid-back look that allows the wearer to seamlessly blend into Parisian streets like the Marais district. Vogue : https://www.vogue.com/article/wide-leg-french-girl-jeans

articles.title: Tom Holland and Zendaya Confirm Romantic Relationship
articles.summary: Their on-screen chemistry as Peter Parker and MJ had been building since they first met on set in 2016, but it wasn't until 2021 that the rumors of a real-life romance were officially confirmed.
articles.content: Spider-Man co-stars Zendaya and Tom Holland confirmed their romantic relationship in 2021, putting an end to years of speculation about their personal lives. Their on-screen chemistry as Peter Parker and MJ had been building since they first met on set in 2016, but it wasn't until 2021 that the rumors of a real-life romance were officially confirmed. The couple's relationship has been shrouded in secrecy, with both actors keeping their private lives under wraps. However, their initial meeting on the Spider-Man set marked the beginning of a long-term connection that would eventually blossom into romance. In July 2016, Tom Holland was the first to share a photo of Zendaya on his social media platform, and soon they were frequently appearing in each other's Instagram feeds. As the months went by, it became increasingly clear that Zendaya and Tom Holland's friendship was blossoming into something more. The two had been paired together for numerous promotional events, including the Spider-Man: Homecoming premiere in June. In an interview with People before the premiere, Holland gushed about his friendship with Zendaya, highlighting their close bond. He described her as "so great and amazing, and shared a lighthearted moment when he joked about taking vacations together, despite having been unable to take one in years. For her part, Zendaya also spoke highly of Holland, calling him a great dude and one of her closest friends. She emphasized the importance of independence during young adulthood, explaining that it's difficult to be in a committed relationship when both partners are still figuring out life and making mistakes along the way. Zendaya noted that people often make poor decisions due to their limited experience and understanding of what's right and wrong. She stressed that individuals cannot change one another, and that relationships can be challenging when both parties are navigating uncharted territory. The timeline of Zendaya and Tom Holland's romance has been a subject of much speculation over the years. Although they were spotted together at the Oscars in March 2018, they walked the red carpet separately, suggesting that their relationship was still in its early stages. As the months went by, Zendaya attended high-profile events like the Met Gala in May 2018, where she wore a striking Joan of Arc-inspired Versace gown. Tom Holland took notice and posted a photo of her on his Instagram account, praising her with the caption All hail the queen. His admiration was likely intended to be lighthearted, but it sparked further rumors about their relationship. The following month, in June 2018, Zendaya made a playful gesture towards Tom Holland by posting a video of him goofing off with a lightsaber. The tongue-in-cheek message accompanying the clip read Me, myself and the birthday girl, which seemed to hint at her affection for the actor. However, she quickly clarified that she was not the one who had posted the comment. When asked about their relationship in June 2019, Tom Holland denied any romantic involvement with Zendaya, stating that he is single and looking for someone special. Interestingly, he described himself as definitely a relationship person, which could suggest that he values commitment and partnership in his relationships. The couple's relationship was still in its early stages when Tom Holland shared a mirror selfie of himself with Zendaya on set in September 2021. Zendaya marked her birthday that month with a post showcasing photos of herself on the red carpet at the Venice Film Festival, wearing a striking Balmain dress. It wasn't long before she stepped out again, this time alongside co-star Timothée Chalamet to promote the film Dune. The couple's relationship continued to blossom in early September when they celebrated Zendaya's 26th birthday together at MAMO Italian restaurant in Manhattan. The actress opted for a relaxed yet stylish look, pairing low-waisted denim jeans with a black crop top and long sleeves that were secured with a few buttons. Her co-stars from Euphoria also joined them for the celebration. Hunter Schafer was among those who attended the birthday gathering at MAMO Italian restaurant. The casual setting provided an opportunity for Zendaya to unwind and spend quality time with her loved ones, including Holland, who arrived dressed in a blue plaid button-down shirt and dark teal pants. His outfit was completed with white sneakers that added a touch of sportiness. In an interview shortly after winning the Emmy Award for her performance as Rue on Euphoria, Zendaya spoke about her relationship with Holland when asked who she texted first to share the news. She replied, Well, I didn’t have to text my mom because my mom was already there, she’s here tonight, which is very special. The question marked a brief moment of introspection for the actress. The celebration at MAMO Italian restaurant was not the only occasion when Zendaya and Holland were spotted together in September. They also had a low-key coffee date at Tatte on Boylston Street, where they seemed to be enjoying each other's company without drawing too much attention to themselves. Their visit to the Louvre in Paris last October was a subtle yet public display of affection. Zendaya and Holland strolled hand-in-hand through the museum's galleries, taking in the famous artwork on display. The casual atmosphere allowed them to be themselves without drawing too much attention. On that day, Zendaya sported a light blue blouse with her sleeves rolled up, her hair tied back in a bun with loose tendrils framing her face. Holland opted for a more understated look in a white and black striped shirt with long sleeves and black pants. His short hair was slightly tousled, adding to his effortless charm. As the months passed, fans noticed Holland resurfacing on social media after a summer break. A fan edit showcasing Zendaya's versatility in various outfits gained popularity, eventually catching her boyfriend's attention. The caption just zendaya owning the camera" aptly summarized the clip, highlighting Zendaya's confidence and poise. articles.title: Iranians Flee Homeland Amid Economic Turmoil and Conflict
articles.summary: A growing number of young Iranians are fleeing their homeland in search of better opportunities abroad due to the death of Jina Mahsa Amini, the US-Israel war with Iran, and economic mismanagement.
articles.content: A growing number of young Iranians are fleeing their homeland in search of better opportunities abroad. The decision to leave was triggered by a series of events, including the death in custody of 22-year-old Jina Mahsa Amini in 2022. The Iranian-Kurdish woman had been arrested for allegedly violating Iran's strict dress code, sparking widespread protests and inspiring the "Woman, Life, Freedom" movement. Amini's death was a turning point for many young Iranians who felt that their future in the country was uncertain. They began to question the morality police's authority and the hijab mandate enforced by authorities. The physician, who wished to remain anonymous, explained that her decision to leave Iran was also influenced by the US-Israel war with Iran. She had been living with her family in a rented apartment in Turkey since early summer, hoping to eventually continue on to Germany. She had applied for an appointment at the German Embassy in Tehran two years ago but faced significant delays due to bureaucratic hurdles. Her professional qualifications were only recognized in Germany after a lengthy process. The escalating conflict in Iran has sparked a growing exodus of young talent from the country, with many seeking refuge in neighboring Turkey. Turkey's relaxed visa policy for Iranian citizens allows them to enter without a visa for up to 90 days, making it an attractive option for those fleeing the conflict. A significant number of Iranians have already crossed into Turkey since the latest conflict began, with thousands more attempting to secure their stay through residence permits rather than seeking asylum. Many of these individuals are skilled professionals and academics who hope to settle permanently in Europe or North America, disillusioned by Iran's war-hit economy and the prospect of little future there. The turmoil in Iran has been compounded by decades of sanctions and economic mismanagement, with a US naval blockade of Iranian ports in the Gulf disrupting oil exports, trade, and government revenues. The economic pressures imposed by sanctions and mismanagement have led to a decline in Iran's ability to provide its citizens with essential services. Basic necessities like food, housing, healthcare, and education are becoming increasingly unaffordable for many people. As a result of the worsening conditions, individuals are being forced to make difficult decisions about their future. Some, like physicians, are choosing to stay abroad until circumstances improve in Iran. However, others, including those who initially moved to Turkey, have decided to return home and submit new visa applications from within the country. The improved situation at the German embassy in Tehran has prompted some individuals to reconsider their plans for immigration. Unmarried friends of a physician, who had previously spent significant sums maintaining their stay in Turkey, are now returning to Iran to apply for visas from home. Many Iranians are weighing the risks and benefits of emigration, particularly those with family ties abroad. They must balance the uncertainty of waiting for family reunification visas against the possibility of new conflicts erupting in the region. The brain drain caused by the departure of highly qualified professionals and students has become a pressing concern for Iranian society as a whole. It's estimated that few families remain untouched by emigration, with many others considering leaving due to the dire economic situation. The University of Guilan's 2025 study on social participation and emigration intentions among Iranian students has shed light on a concerning trend. Researchers discovered a significant correlation between limited opportunities for shaping one's future in Iran and a higher likelihood of considering emigration. Economic concerns are not the sole driving force behind this trend, as many young Iranians feel constrained by their country's strict social and political environment. A sense of powerlessness and limited participation in decision-making processes have become major push factors for emigration. For some, securing a spot at a foreign university is already within reach. Mahsa, a mid-twenties student, has secured admission to a German university, paving the way for her departure from Iran. Others, like Ali, are taking steps towards leaving, with his long-term goal of obtaining a stronger qualification and eventually departing. Ali's plans are ambitious: he aims to secure a scholarship that will allow him to leave Iran in pursuit of a better future. articles.title: Bangladeshi batter Litton Das scores century against South Africa in Johannesburg
articles.summary: Litton Das scored his eighth Test hundred and dedicated it to his daughter Anayra, who had her birthday the same day.
articles.content: Bangladeshi batter Litton Das made his daughter's birthday a special occasion by scoring a century against South Africa in the first Test at Johannesburg's Wanderers stadium. The emotional celebration was a way for Das to make up for not being able to be with his "little princess Anayra on her birthday. Das's eighth Test hundred had a personal touch, as he dedicated it to Anayra with a handwritten message that he held up for the cameras after reaching three figures on the second morning. The note was a heartfelt expression of love and appreciation from Das to his daughter. The message read: Happy Birthday to my Princess." This gesture by Das was all the more significant given that he had already shown his affection for Anayra through a social media post before the match. Das's emotional moment was palpable as he displayed the handwritten note, highlighting the special bond between him and his daughter. The recovery by Bangladesh was nothing short of remarkable as they overcame a disastrous start to their innings. After being reduced to 22/3 within nine overs, thanks largely to Kagiso Rabada's destructive bowling, it seemed like the visitors were in for a long haul. However, Towhid Hridoy and Tanzid Hasan soon showed why they are considered Bangladesh's future stars with a stabilizing partnership that changed the course of the game. They put on 99 runs for the fourth wicket before Rabada struck again, sending Tanzid back to the pavilion after he had scored 67 off 108 deliveries. But Hridoy continued his impressive form in Test cricket, scoring his second century in just seven innings with a well-crafted 137 off 227 balls. His partnership with Litton Das was what turned the game around for Bangladesh as they began to put up a strong fight against their South African opponents. Das's recent performance in a match against the West Indies had been nothing short of exceptional, where he struck an impressive 224 runs. By that standard, his half-century on the first day was well within reach, and he achieved it off just 71 deliveries, leaving him unbeaten on 92 at the end of the day's play. It was only a matter of time before Das would go on to score a Test century against South Africa, becoming the third Bangladesh batter to achieve this milestone in the process. Das eventually fell for 120 runs after a well-crafted innings that included 14 fours and a six, caught by Marco Jansen off Dane Paterson's bowling. Paterson was instrumental in South Africa's fightback on the second day, claiming four wickets at an economical rate of 92 runs. Rabada chipped in with five crucial wickets for 51 runs, while Jansen took two wickets to help bowl Bangladesh out for 400 before lunch. The early exchanges of the South African innings were marked by caution, but their progress was soon halted when Aiden Markram was caught behind off Hasan Mahmud's bowling without reaching double figures. The hosts were left reeling at 18/1 by lunchtime. Paterson's impressive performance with the ball had been a key factor in restricting Bangladesh's scoring rate, and his four wickets for 92 runs will be a valuable contribution to South Africa's cause. In the end, it was a day that belonged to both Das and Paterson, as they left their mark on the proceedings with outstanding performances. articles.title: Robert Pattinson Chosen to Play James Bond in Franchise's 26th Installment
articles.summary: The decision marks a significant milestone for the franchise, which has been part of British cinema history for 64 years.
articles.content: British actor Robert Pattinson has been chosen to play the iconic James Bond in the 26th installment of the franchise. The decision comes at a time when the film series is experiencing its longest hiatus on record. Fans have been eagerly speculating about who would take over the role left vacant by Daniel Craig, and their wait is finally over. Five years after "No Time to Die, the first Bond film to conclude with the character's demise, 007 will be reborn in a new movie directed by Denis Villeneuve. The announcement marks a significant milestone for the franchise, which has been part of British cinema history for 64 years. Pattinson's involvement in the project has generated immense excitement among fans and industry insiders alike. His statement on being chosen as Bond is testament to his enthusiasm: James Bond is one of the most legendary characters in cinema, and to be entrusted with 007 is the honour of a lifetime, he said. The decision to cast Robert Pattinson as James Bond was not without its challenges for producers, who had to sift through an impressive pool of talented actors vying for the role. The list of contenders included Callum Turner, Josh O'Connor, Jack Lowden, and Nicholas Hoult, all of whom were reportedly in the running. In a surprising move, the producers opted for a well-established actor over a younger, lesser-known star. Pattinson, who is 40 years old, brings a level of experience to the role that may be unexpected given the character's typical age profile as Bond. His selection also marks a departure from the conventional choice of a young actor. Pattinson has already established himself in various iconic roles across multiple franchises, including The Batman," "Twilight," and "Harry Potter. However, his work since Twilight has been marked by a shift towards more independent films, such as Good Time with the Safdie brothers and Robert Eggers' The Lighthouse. The casting of Robert Pattinson as James Bond marks a significant shift for the franchise, which has undergone substantial changes behind the scenes in recent years. The acquisition of MGM by Amazon in 2022 brought about a new era of uncertainty, with producers Barbara Broccoli and Michael G. Wilson relinquishing their creative control in 2025. This decision handed over the reins to new producers Amy Pascal and David Heyman, who have been tasked with steering the franchise forward. Pascal's experience as former Sony Pictures chief and producer on Spider-Man brings a fresh perspective, while Heyman's work on Harry Potter" and "Paddington has earned him a reputation for crafting beloved franchises. The search for Bond's next incarnation has been ongoing since Daniel Craig departed the role, with numerous names being touted in the media. Idris Elba has been one of the most persistent candidates, having repeatedly denied or dodged speculation about his involvement in the franchise. The production of Bond 26 will be the first installment not to be overseen by a Broccoli family member since the debut film Dr. No in 1962. This change signals a new era for the franchise, with Pascal and Heyman at the helm alongside scriptwriter Steven Knight, who has brought his expertise from projects like Peaky Blinders" and "Locke. The delay between Craig's final Bond outing and the release of Bond 26 will be the longest in the franchise's history. With principal photography on No Time to Die" wrapping up in 2019 before its eventual release, the lull has been exacerbated by the pandemic-induced delays. The announcement of Robert Pattinson as the new James Bond has sparked mixed reactions from fans. Some are concerned that Amazon's control over the franchise will alter its legacy and direction. However, Mike Hopkins, head of Prime Video and Amazon MGM Studios, has reassured audiences that he intends to preserve the Bond brand's heritage. At stake is a lucrative film series based on Ian Fleming's novels, which has generated over $7 billion in worldwide ticket sales. The Bond movies have also spawned numerous spin-offs, including streaming deals, video games, and even partnerships with luxury car brands like Aston Martin. These revenue streams contribute significantly to the franchise's overall value. While some previous Bond actors may have viewed the role as a burden, it catapulted Daniel Craig into international stardom, transforming him from an unknown British actor into a household name. Despite initial skepticism about his suitability for the part due to his blonde hair, Craig proved himself to be a capable and charismatic Bond. articles.title: CEOs Prioritize Cost-Cutting Over Growth with Artificial Intelligence
articles.summary: A recent survey found that 63% of large US corporations are using AI for cost-cutting and productivity gains, while only 7% use it to diversify revenue streams.
articles.content: CEOs are flocking to artificial intelligence as a cost-cutting measure, but few have a plan to use it to drive growth. The majority of top executives I've spoken with have an AI strategy focused on reducing expenses, but this approach falls short in today's business environment. Over the past five decades, I've had the privilege of helping launch more than 175 companies and watching multiple technological waves transform industries. The initial reaction is often to leverage the new tool for efficiency gains, rather than exploring innovative applications. A recent survey by EY-Parthenon found that a staggering 63% of growth leaders at large U.S. corporations are using AI primarily to streamline operations and boost productivity, while only 7% are employing it to diversify revenue streams. The use of artificial intelligence in business is not just about cutting costs and boosting productivity, but also about creating new growth opportunities. AI has made it possible for companies to experiment with ideas more freely, without breaking the bank. For software-based concepts, this means that teams can research markets, write and test code, and build initial prototypes before committing significant resources. This allows businesses to validate their ideas early on and make informed decisions about where to focus their efforts. Established companies have a wealth of expertise and knowledge at their disposal, including customer insights, patents, trade secrets, and shelved research. These assets can be leveraged to identify new business opportunities, but it requires a structured approach to turn them into revenue-generating ideas. At Idealab, we've developed a method for finding business ideas that has been refined over three decades. Our framework consists of 31 ways to identify opportunities, grouped into seven distinct lenses. By applying this approach in conjunction with AI, we've created a database of over 1.2 million potential business ideas that are freely available at Idealab.ai. The key to unlocking growth through AI is to start by identifying areas where friction, waste, or danger exist in an industry or business. Customer-support logs can be a rich source of information on these pain points, highlighting problems that are worth solving. By applying the "make it radically better" principle, companies can identify opportunities to automate processes, simplify complex tasks, and make services more convenient for customers. This involves asking what could be done dramatically faster, simpler, or more automated, with AI playing a key role in exploring possibilities. Another approach is to open up premium services to new customer groups by reducing costs. What would this make possible? By cutting prices, companies can tap into underserved markets and create new revenue streams. This requires careful analysis of the market and an understanding of what customers are willing to pay for. When analyzing pain points, companies should look at signals left by customers, such as repeated questions, complaints, workarounds, misuse, broken trust, and ignored niches. When analyzing customer behavior and feedback, it's essential to apply multiple lenses to identify opportunities for growth. These lenses include expertise, customer knowledge, capabilities, and intellectual property - all of which should be run against each other to uncover hidden potential. The goal is to challenge assumptions and test demand directly with customers through methods such as customer interviews or paid pilots. By doing so, companies can learn what people actually need and whether they will pay for it. Assigning an accountable owner to the strongest opportunity ensures that resources are focused on the most promising areas. Clear milestones should be set for deciding whether to invest further, change direction, or stop pursuing a particular avenue of growth. articles.title: Record Low Unemployment Filing Numbers
articles.summary: The number of Americans filing for unemployment has reached a record low over the past four weeks.
articles.content: The number of Americans filing for unemployment has reached a record low over the past four weeks, sparking optimism in the job market. According to Goldman Sachs, this trend is expected to continue for at least another year before AI-driven layoffs start to take hold. Goldman's economists have been warning that the impact of AI on jobs will be delayed, but not avoided. They describe the current employment landscape as a "slightly softer low-hire, low-fire form of full employment" which is likely to persist for now. However, they predict that this stability will eventually give way to significant job losses due to automation. Goldman's economists have been making this argument for some time, pointing out that AI-driven layoffs are not yet apparent because the overall economy remains healthy. They argue that it's only when a recession hits that the full consequences of AI on jobs will become clear. This is supported by historical data which shows that job losses accelerated during previous recessions. The experts warn that workers in routine jobs, such as clerks and machine operators, are most at risk of being displaced by automation. Goldman economist Joseph Briggs estimates that up to 9% of workers could be affected during the AI transition. This is because automation-related labor disruption tends to accelerate during cyclical slowdowns. The McKinsey Global Institute has also projected significant job displacement in the US, with between 6 million and 16 million workers potentially needing to switch occupations by 2035. At this midpoint estimate of about 7% of current employees, it's clear that AI-driven layoffs are not just a future concern but a looming reality. The labor market's current state suggests a different outcome than predicted by some experts. While stagnant hiring and elevated layoffs were anticipated as a result of AI adoption, the numbers so far indicate a more nuanced picture. According to the Labor Department's latest JOLTS report, employers made 5.4 million hires in September, but at a rate that is not significantly higher than usual. The job market's performance can be measured by various indicators, and one such metric is initial jobless claims. These rose by 9,000 to 200,000 in the week ended November 7. Notably, the four-week average remained flat at 195,000, a level that Goldman considers the lowest in the series' history. In comparison with previous years, this year's weekly claims numbers are relatively low. According to Reuters, they reached as low as 189,000 in mid-July, which is the lowest since 1969. In contrast, last year at this time saw significantly higher claims of 228,000. Goldman also notes that wage growth has slowed down to a "subdued pace of about 3.5%. This level of wage growth may be lower than what some experts had anticipated. It's worth noting that the current economic outlook still sees GDP growth at 2.4% in 2027, which is above consensus estimates. However, there are also differing opinions on the impact of AI on employment. Some researchers suggest that AI will not lead to widespread job losses, but rather augment existing work. Princeton computer scientists Arvind Narayanan and Sayash Kapoor have called AI a normal technology in their 2025 essay. Narayanan has argued that while AI may change the nature of certain jobs, it is unlikely to eliminate vast swaths of white-collar work. He compares work to a sandwich whose bun is growing even as the meat shrinks. This means that more tasks are being added around a smaller core, rather than entire professions being replaced. The World Bank's data on global growth has been cited by Richard Hanania in his recent essay as evidence that the predicted AI layoff wave may not be imminent. According to the data, the average annual growth rate from 2010 to 2019 was 3.2%, while it dropped slightly to 2.9% between 2023 and 2025. This relatively stable economic backdrop has led Hanania to question whether the dire predictions made by some AI experts are actually on track. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei had previously forecast that AI could wipe out half of entry-level white-collar jobs and push unemployment rates up to 20% within a short period. However, Hanania argues that this scenario is far from inevitable and requires a closer examination of the role of human psychology in shaping our economic systems. He suggests that rather than being driven by purely rational calculations, decision-making processes are influenced by a range of factors. In his essay, Hanania identifies several reasons why middle managers might choose to retain employees even when AI can perform their tasks with ease. One key reason is the need for human interaction and supervision, as evidenced by the desire to have people to boss around. This highlights the complex interplay between technology, management, and human relationships in the workplace. The role of sticky norms, deeply ingrained social and cultural practices that resist change, has also been emphasized by Hanania. He argues that these norms put real limits on how efficiently an economy can operate, even when automation and AI are available. This means that while some jobs may indeed become obsolete, many others will find ways to adapt and continue. As Mechanize, the startup behind the essay's sponsorship, aims to automate all work, Hanania's analysis raises important questions about the relationship between technology and employment. While acknowledging that some jobs will inevitably disappear, he suggests that human ingenuity and adaptability will ultimately ensure that many current roles find a way to survive, at least for now. The Digital Economy Lab's findings suggest that AI has not led to widespread job displacement, contradicting earlier predictions of an AI layoff wave". However, the data does reveal a concerning trend: young workers in industries heavily impacted by automation are being hired at significantly lower rates than their peers in less exposed sectors. Specifically, employment among 22- to 25-year-olds in AI-exposed jobs is about 19% below where it would be if they had kept pace with similarly aged workers in non-AI sectors. This discrepancy has been growing steadily, increasing from a 15% deficit just one year ago. The researchers note that this pattern may not necessarily imply causality, but rather describes the current state of affairs. They attribute the reduced hiring of young workers to the primary mechanism driving these trends, rather than increased separations or layoffs. Goldman Sachs attributes its own earlier forecast to a straightforward economic reality: companies tend to automate and shed labor costs when the economy is slowing down. This makes sense given historical patterns, but it's not the only possible explanation for why work and jobs exist in the first place. According to one expert, there may be more fundamental reasons at play. These reasons include human connections and social interactions that occur in a workplace setting. For instance, having colleagues to talk to and share meals with can provide a sense of belonging and community. While this may not be a traditional productivity-focused or capitalistic reason for work, it highlights the importance of human relationships in our lives. articles.title: US Supreme Court Declines to Hear Challenge to Maryland's Gun Laws
articles.summary: The US Supreme Court has declined to hear a challenge to Maryland's laws on carrying firearms in public areas.
articles.content: The US Supreme Court has made a significant decision regarding Maryland's laws on carrying firearms in public areas. In a move that may have far-reaching implications, the court declined to hear a broad challenge to the state's restrictions on gun ownership. Maryland's laws prohibit carrying firearms in various locations such as state parks, public transportation, schools, healthcare facilities, and establishments that serve alcohol. The court's decision not to review these measures means they will remain in place for now. This outcome has been met with mixed reactions from those who advocate for stricter gun control and those who support the Second Amendment. The Supreme Court's conservative majority has previously issued rulings that have expanded the scope of the Constitution's Second Amendment, which protects the right to bear arms. However, this time around, the court chose not to intervene in Maryland's laws. Some lawmakers are concerned about the potential impact on public safety and security. The decision comes after a previous ruling by the Supreme Court last year that recognized for the first time a right to carry a firearm outside of one's home. In response, some states, including Maryland, enacted new measures to regulate gun ownership in public areas. The Supreme Court's 2022 ruling on gun restrictions has set a new precedent for judges evaluating laws related to firearms. In assessing these laws, judges are now required to focus solely on whether they align with the historical understanding of the Second Amendment. This shift in focus is significant, as it requires courts to examine gun regulations through the lens of the past. Gun rights advocates point out that there has been a long-standing tradition of banning firearms in certain locations, such as polling places and courthouses. However, these advocates argue that states like Maryland have overstepped their bounds by extending these bans to modern public areas like airports and entertainment districts. They contend that the restrictions imposed by Maryland are overly broad, severely limiting the ability to carry firearms in public. Maryland officials, according to lawyers challenging the state's law, have shown "open hostility towards gun rights. These lawyers represent individual residents who wish to carry guns in public as well as four gun rights groups, and argue that the restrictions imposed by Maryland are unreasonable. Maryland's gun ban on sensitive places has been upheld by the Supreme Court, marking another setback for gun rights activists who had hoped to challenge the law. A similar provision was struck down in a Hawaii law last month when the court ruled that private properties open to the public cannot restrict people from bringing firearms onto their premises. The ruling highlighted the ongoing debate over what constitutes sensitive places" and how gun laws should be applied in modern contexts. articles.summary: President Donald Trump said he would not object to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang returning to his role following allegations of extramarital relationships.
articles.content: A surprise revelation emerged from White House comments on Monday: President Donald Trump expressed a willingness to see Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO of Nvidia after his departure following allegations of extramarital relationships. Specifically, he stated that Huang's return would not be an issue for him. In the same comments, Trump reiterated his support for former Apple CEO Tim Cook to take over at Nvidia if Huang were unable to resume his role. It is worth noting that Huang stepped down as CEO amid controversy, including one high-profile relationship with a woman deemed by intelligence officials to have ties to Chinese intelligence agencies. Nvidia is currently conducting an internal investigation into allegations surrounding former CEO Jensen Huang's personal relationships and export arrangements that may have compromised the company's policies. The probe, led by an outside law firm, aims to determine whether Huang's actions had any adverse impact on Nvidia's operations or compliance with regulatory requirements. A petition calling for Huang's reinstatement has gained significant traction online, with over 180,000 signatures in support of his return to the top spot at Nvidia. High-profile tech industry figures such as Elon Musk and Travis Kalanick have expressed their backing for the effort to bring Huang back to Nvidia. The Commerce Department has issued a new chip-exports rule that aims to close a loophole used by some companies to skirt export restrictions for advanced American AI semiconductors. This move is seen as a response to national security concerns raised by the agency's Bureau of Industry and Security. Secretary Howard Lutnick's comments on Monday appeared to both elevate and undermine these concerns, however. By attributing the new restrictions to the Treasury Department and the National Security Council, the Commerce Department effectively distanced itself from its own rule, leaving some questions about its commitment to addressing national security issues. articles.title: Tesla Begins Inviting Customers to Purchase Cybercab Robotaxi
articles.summary: Tesla has begun inviting select customers to purchase its Cybercab robotaxi, which requires a monthly autonomy subscription and comes with strict usage restrictions.
articles.content: Tesla has begun inviting select customers to purchase its Cybercab, a steering-wheel-less robotaxi designed for personal use and ride-hailing services. The Cybercab comes in two packages: an initial purchase price of $29,990, plus a monthly "autonomy subscription that costs $299. This is not just an optional feature, but a requirement to operate the vehicle at all. According to Tesla's Cybercab order and subscription agreements, which were made public over the weekend, the autonomous EV will not function without a valid autonomy subscription in place. In essence, this means owners who fail to pay the monthly fee risk having their vehicle rendered useless. Those who do receive an invite to purchase a Cybercab will be limited to using it within specific areas designated for Tesla's Robotaxi ride-hailing service. Currently, these areas include parts of Texas and Florida, such as Austin, Dallas, Miami, Orlando, and Tampa. The fine print of Tesla's Cybercab subscription agreement reveals some surprising conditions for owners who fail to pay the $299 monthly fee. If a customer defaults on their payment, they face a hefty penalty of $50,000. But that's not all - Tesla also reserves the right to remotely disable the vehicle, essentially turning it into an expensive paperweight. The company can repurchase the Cybercab at any time, with the price determined by its own valuation, but there's no guarantee that owners will get a replacement vehicle. Other terms of the agreement include restrictions on modifying the Cybercab, including adding wraps or tinted windows. This means owners won't be able to personalize their vehicles as they see fit. Tesla is also collecting data from Cybercab owners, which will be used to improve the product and provide ride support. The company will have access to personally identifying information such as location data and images recorded by a camera above the rear-view mirror, but it's unclear whether owners can opt out of this data collection. Tesla's Cybercab is set to become a subscription-only vehicle, marking a significant shift in the company's business model towards tech-driven revenue streams. The decision follows Musk's announcement earlier this month that Tesla would discontinue the Cybertruck, after previously phasing out the Model S and X earlier this year. This move underscores Tesla's focus on autonomous driving technologies, as hinted at by Musk's vision for future revenue sources. Notably, early invitees to order the Cybercab include tech reviewer Marques Brownlee, who had been skeptical about Tesla's ability to deliver a sub-$30,000 Cybercab by 2026. However, after receiving his confirmed order, he shared a screenshot on social media and expressed relief that his hair was safe. The Cybercab's geofencing limitations mean it can only be used in specific locations, falling short of Musk's promise for personal robotaxis. When taken home, Brownlee quipped that the vehicle would become a paperweight." articles.title: Blanket Coats Take Center Stage in Fashion Collections
articles.summary: Designers like Colleen Allen and TWP are showcasing oversized scarf shawls turned into coats on their fall/winter 2026 runways.
articles.content: The latest trend in fashion is all about wraps, shawls, and capes that serve as elevated versions of blanket coats. At the forefront of this trend are designers like Colleen Allen and TWP who showcased supersized scarf shawls turned into coats on their fall/winter 2026 runways. The oversized designs were draped elegantly over models, exuding a sense of comfort and warmth. These wearable wraps have become a staple in many fashion collections. But what sets the blanket coat apart from other winter staples? For one, it offers a unique feel that's more about wrapping oneself in warmth than making a bold statement like a black puffer jacket might. The blanket coat has also taken on a symbolic significance, representing both physical and metaphorical well-being in today's chaotic world. Models at Fforme walked the runway draped in huge swaths of furry fabrics that enveloped them completely, evoking images of being swaddled. At Khaite, dresses were styled with large cocooning blanket-like throws trailing off the backs, adding to the overall sense of warmth and comfort. Designers are embracing comfort as a core theme in their collections, blurring the lines between practicality and whimsy. The blanket coat has become a staple in many designers' visions, often styled to resemble a cozy throw wrapped around one's shoulders. This trend is not unlike taking a piece of home with you on-the-go, bringing a sense of familiarity and warmth to the outside world. In show notes for TWP's fall/winter 2026 collection, founder Trish Wescoat Pound referenced inviting elements like hot toddies, jigsaw puzzles, and fireplaces alongside warm fabrics such as Scottish cashmere. The blanket coat has become a staple in many fashion collections, with smaller brands like LilyEve offering unique takes on the trend. These brands are able to create one-of-a-kind pieces by upcycling vintage materials, such as hand-sourced Hermès blankets.
